퀘스트 설명 (한국어 · 자체 번역)

커닝시티의 라케리스가 용감한 탐험가들을 찾고 있어요. 다른 이들과 힘을 합쳐 미션을 완수하고 강력한 라케리스를 물리치세요!
[확인 중]는 퀴즈를 풀고 질문에 답할 패스를 충분히 모으면 나타나요. 그다음에는 답에 맞는 장소를 골라야 해요.

- 제한 시간: 30분
- 참가 인원: 3 - 6

퀘스트 설명 (영문 원문)

라케리스 of 커닝시티 is searching for brave explorers. Join forces with others to complete the missions and defeat the powerful 라케리스!
[확인 중] will appear after you complete quizzes and gather enough passes to answer questions. Then, you'll have to select the correct location for the answers.

- Time Limit: 30 min
- Players: 3 - 6

퀘스트 설명 (영문 원문)

In Lith Harbor, you meet a heavily-bearded crewmember of The Victoria called Teo. He says he has some Weird Medicine but he isn't willing to give it up for free. Instead he says he'll trade it for a sparkling rock. He seems like he knows Maya pretty well, yet he still wants a favor first, knowing how sick Maya is? Creep. Anyway, to get the sparkling rock, you should head to Perion and talk to Sophia, the daughter of the owner of the General Store there.

You meet Sophia in the General Store in Perion. She's working on her dream to be an alchemist. To make the sparkling rock, she says she needs 50 squishy liquids, 50 leaves, 20 octopus legs and 1 Arcon's blood. Everything looks reasonable enough...wait, Arcon's blood?! Fortunately, Sophia knows where to get some. She says to have a chat with Manji, who's somewhere around Perion.
